feeds.title: Hongda Service Blog
feeds.description: Interested in doing business in China and the PRD? Our informative blog features WOFE setup, monthly China accounting, taxes in China, and more! Hongda Business Services has been assisting foreign companies with setting up and managing local Chinese businesses. Our local China experts are fluent in English and Chinese and specialize in the disciplines you need.
